IN THE  HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION 
CRIMINAL WRIT PETITION NO. 3203 OF 2025
Mr. Zain Nafis Haider Sayyed ..Petitioner
Vs.
The State Of Maharashtra & Anr. ..Respondents
_______________________________
Mr. Karim Pathan a/w. Mr. Shane Illahi Turky , Mr. Fazal Shaikh, Mr. Fardeen
Shaikh for Petitioner.
Mr. Ajay Patil APP , APP for Respondent No.1-State.
_______________________________
CORAM  : A. S. GADKARI AND
RAJESH S. PATIL, JJ.
           DATE      :    20th JUNE, 2025.
P .C.:-
1. Issue notice to Respondent No.2, returnable on 8th August 2025.
2. Learned Advocate for Petitioner is directed to supply spare copies of
Petition in the Registry of this Court within a period of two weeks from
today ,  failing  which  the  Petition  shall  stand  dismissed  without  further
reference to this Court.
3. Stand over to 8th August 2025.
        (RAJESH S. PATIL, J.)                 (A.S. GADKARI, J.)
